notes: «زرت عائشة مع عبيد بن عمير فسألها» is Ata's own account: Ubayd asks inside the story, so he is not a link (rule 5)
Aisha answers («فقالت لا هجرة اليوم»): her words are the saying, so she is the last link (rule 6)
RWY's chain names عبيد بن عمير; the text does not make him a transmitter here, so he is not read as one
